hypotheses.C0_full_restricted_program_recovers_natu: Replacing the exact pooled write by the complete natural-rank32 quadratic program recovers at least 0.80 of the pooled-component ablation KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.C1_selected_graph_recovers_natural_effec: The diagonal-plus-32-selected-edge program recovers at least 0.70 of pooled-component ablation KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.C2_selected_graph_matches_full_restricte: Selected-graph recovery is within 0.10 of complete restricted-program recovery on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_selected_graph_beats_random: Selected-graph recovery exceeds a matched random-edge graph by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_selected_graph_preserves_predictions: Selected-graph replacement preserves native top-1 predictions on at least 98% of sites and raises mean next-token CE by at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_boundary_sites_are_not_the_only_use: On non-newline sites, selected-graph recovery remains at least 0.60 on every corpus.
